Implementation approach: Preserve Maven protocol files exactly: pom.xml, src/main/java/Main.java, src/test/java/MainTest.java, with test command mvn -q test. Keep Main.java in the default package; all other Java classes also in the default package (no package declarations). Use Java 11 language features and no external non-test dependencies. Separate pure domain logic (Board, MoveResult, Direction, Spawner, SequenceSpawner, Spawn, GameStatus, Game) from the environment-dependent entry (Main). Provide a deterministic, headless, console-only demo in Main. Tests use JUnit Jupiter and Surefire configured for JUnit 5. Full API rules repeated and enforced across design and tasks: Board is the sole owner of the authoritative 4x4 int grid; getGridCopy() returns a deep snapshot and must never be used for mutation; declare and consistently use the exact mutation API void setCell(int row, int col, int value) with bounds checks and 0-or-power-of-two validation; Board.hasTileAtLeast(int value) is the exact win detector; MoveResult is immutable, with exact accessors boolean changed() and int scoreGained(); Board.move(Direction) processes each row/column by reading exactly four values in movement order, compacting nonzeros, merging one equal adjacent pair at most once per adjacency, compacting/filling with zeros, writing back exactly four results, and summing newly formed merged tile values into scoreGained; Game.move(Direction) calls Board.move once, increments score by scoreGained, and spawns exactly one tile only when changed() is true and always applies the spawn through Board.setCell; Game updates status after every move attempt including unchanged moves: WON iff Board.hasTileAtLeast(2048), otherwise LOST iff !Board.hasAnyMoves(), otherwise IN_PROGRESS; initialization/reset clears the Board and applies exactly two spawns via Board.setCell; SequenceSpawner consumes its documented sequence strictly in order for both initialization and subsequent spawns.

Game status enumeration: IN_PROGRESS, WON, LOST; updated after every move attempt including unchanged moves

Game orchestration: holds Board, Spawner, score, and status; reset() clears board and applies exactly two spawns via Board.setCell; move(Direction) calls Board.move, adds scoreGained, spawns exactly one tile only when changed(), updates status: WON iff Board.hasTileAtLeast(2048), else LOST iff !Board.hasAnyMoves(), else IN_PROGRESS; getScore(), getStatus(), getGridCopy() proxy

Program call flow:
sequenceDiagram
    participant M as Main
    participant G as Game
    participant S as SequenceSpawner
    participant B as Board
    M->>S: defaultSequence()
    M->>B: new Board()
    M->>G: new Game(B, S)
    M->>G: reset()
    G->>B: clear()
    G->>S: nextSpawn()
    S-->>G: Spawn(r,c,val)
    G->>B: setCell(r,c,val)
    G->>S: nextSpawn()
    S-->>G: Spawn(r2,c2,val2)
    G->>B: setCell(r2,c2,val2)
    M->>G: move(Direction.LEFT)
    G->>B: move(LEFT)
    B-->>G: MoveResult(changed, scoreGained)
    alt changed==true
        G->>S: nextSpawn()
        S-->>G: Spawn(sr,sc,sv)
        G->>B: setCell(sr,sc,sv)
    end
    G->>G: updateStatus(WON/LOST/IN_PROGRESS)
    M-->>M: print grid, score, status
    M-->>M: exit
